name: Tomorrow
description: This keyword returns the next date as a string in format YYYY-MM-DD.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns  the next date as a string in format YYYY-MM-DD.

This keyword should not be equated to a number. It should always be compared with keyword that returns a string in same format

![Example](./images/img-1631875664.png)

The above condition will be true if tomorrow is the current week expiry
